decisions.decision: Print service authenticates via /api/auth instead of static JWT
decisions.rationale: Eliminates duplicated token-generation logic in db_init; print_service user created same way as cadmin; token refresh handled automatically on reconnect

decisions.decision: Added scope field to TokenData model
decisions.rationale: scope was silently dropped from JWT payload; now included so verify_print_service_token can check print_service scope without a DB lookup

decisions.decision: verify_print_service_token checks context=USER_SESSION + scope contains print_service
decisions.rationale: Replaces context=api+consumer_type=3psw check; semantically cleaner — print service is a regular user with restricted scope

decisions.decision: print_service_pwd generated separately from main secrets loop
decisions.rationale: Main secrets loop pipes directly to Docker without saving the value; print service needs it written to a file for compose AND as swarm secret for init-db
